import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,subprocess,sys,time
root=pathlib.Path('/home/andrew-peterson/.codex/worktrees/stdlib-foundation/laniusc');os.chdir(root)
p=pathlib.Path('tests/fixtures/stdlib_compiler_state/complete-callable-owners');p.mkdir(exist_ok=True);mode=sys.argv[1]
selection={'library':['checked_unit_contracts_','retained_symbolic_call_graphs_preserve_caller_binders_after_workspace_reuse','type_checker::generic_body::tests::','compiler::gpu_compiler::body_specialization::tests::'],'native':['ordinary_trait_methods_execute_alongside_generic_value_calls','imported_trait_contract_records_preserve_ordinary_generic_execution','imported_generic_bodies_enforce_their_concrete_trait_contracts','explicit_constant_arguments_execute_independent_method_domains','imported_alias_associated_methods_preserve_complete_receiver_and_own_arguments']}
if mode=='freeze':
 names=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-c','-o','--exclude-standard','-z']).split(b'\0')
 names={os.fsdecode(f) for f in names if f and pathlib.Path(os.fsdecode(f)).suffix in {'.rs','.slang','.lani','.bnf','.py','.toml','.lock'}}
 h={f:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in sorted(names) if pathlib.Path(f).is_file()}
 (p/'frozen-sources.json').write_text(json.dumps(h,indent=2)+'\n');(p/'selection.json').write_text(json.dumps(selection,indent=2)+'\n');print('frozen',len(h));raise SystemExit()
h=json.loads((p/'frozen-sources.json').read_text());changed=lambda:[f for f,v in h.items() if not pathlib.Path(f).is_file() or hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=v]
assert not changed(),changed()
if mode=='native': binary=pathlib.Path('target/stdlib-perf/build/release/deps/compiler_generic_types_execution-443177ec3361c248')
else:
 source=pathlib.Path('target/stdlib-perf/build/release/deps/laniusc_compiler-88bea0616d867d66');binary=pathlib.Path('target/complete-callable-tests/stdlib_gpu_perf');binary.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);binary.unlink(missing_ok=True);os.link(source.resolve(),binary)
command=[str(binary),*selection[mode],'--test-threads=1','--nocapture'];start=time.monotonic();log=p/(mode+'.log')
with log.open('w') as f:
 try: code=subprocess.run(command,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=90).returncode
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: code=124
raw=log.read_text();r={'command':command,'exit_code':code,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'passed':re.findall(r'^test ([\w:]+) \.\.\. ok$',raw,re.M),'summaries':re.findall(r'test result:.*',raw),'frozen_sources_unchanged':not changed()}
(p/(mode+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(r,indent=2));print(raw[-6500:]);raise SystemExit(code)
